answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity’s stake to a common vault and links equivocation evidence across them. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting claims, pairwise-attributed penalties grow as O(k²), not as k independent flat fines. Detection also applies a capital-loss multiplier exp(αk), for α > 0, so a swarm’s recoverable stake falls exponentially with detected scale; hollow identities cannot cheaply echo honest participation without exposing the pooled bond.
